solutions.title: How to Organize PDF Documents Online | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Organize Your PDF Documents Before Submitting Them
solutions.description: Combine, divide, extract, and number PDF pages to prepare files, reports, and delivery documents with Prisma Space.
solutions.intro: When a procedure or submission requires gathering multiple documents, the problem often goes beyond format: order, pagination, and the ability to review the final file are also crucial. This guide brings together operations to prepare a neatly ordered copy without unnecessarily modifying the originals.

steps.title: Gather the Source Files
steps.body: Verify that each PDF opens correctly and preserve an intact copy. If the file contains sensitive data, review the privacy rules before processing it.

steps.title: Order and Select Pages
steps.body: Combine documents in the required order or extract only the pages that should be part of the submission. Do not include attachments out of habit.

steps.title: Adjust Document Reading
steps.body: Correct rotated pages and add numbering when it helps review the file. Verify that the pagination matches the receiving instructions.

steps.title: Review the Final File
steps.body: Open the complete PDF, verify the order, pages, and legibility. Do not consider a submission valid just because the file has been downloaded.

faqs: Can I merge documents of different sizes?
The merge operation preserves the original pages; therefore, the final document may contain different page sizes.
Is it better to delete pages from the original?
Work on a copy and preserve the original. This way, you can recover information if you detect an omission.
solutions.note: The tools resolve specific operations and do not verify legal or administrative requirements for a procedure. Confirm the order and documents required by the receiving entity.

solutions.title: Convert Documents Between PDF, Word, and Text | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Convert Documents Between PDF, Word, and Text Formats
solutions.description: Choose how to convert from PDF to Word, Word to PDF, or between text formats based on the editable result you need.
solutions.intro: Not all conversions aim for the same outcome. Sometimes you need to recover text for editing; other times, you need to prepare a copy that looks consistent when shared. Choose the workflow based on the original document and review what elements may change.

steps.title: Identify the File Type
steps.body: Check if the PDF contains selectable text or if it's a scanned image. A scanned file requires OCR before you can edit its text.

steps.title: Choose the Destination Format
steps.body: Use Word when you need to continue editing the text; choose PDF when you want to share a read-only or print-ready version.

steps.title: Convert and Review the Structure
steps.body: Open the result and compare titles, line breaks, tables, columns, and special characters with the original.

steps.title: Save the Original
steps.body: Save the original version until you confirm that the converted file contains all the necessary information.

faqs: Does PDF to Word Maintain the Original Design?
No, necessarily. Text extraction prioritizes editable text; complex tables, columns, and fonts may require corrections.
Can I Convert a Scanned PDF Directly?
First, you need to recognize the text using OCR. Converting digital PDFs and reading scanned images are distinct processes.
solutions.note: Always check the converted file before signing, presenting, or distributing it. A conversion does not guarantee document fidelity.

solutions.title: Optimize Images for a Web Page | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Prepare Images for Your Web Page
solutions.description: Reduce dimensions and weight, choose a compatible format, and review metadata to prepare images for the web.
solutions.intro: Large images can increase download time and consume data, but reducing them without criteria can also degrade details. A useful workflow starts by defining the display size, choosing a format, and comparing the result with the original.

steps.title: Define the Necessary Dimensions
steps.body: Measure the actual space where the image will appear. Don't upload a photo with thousands of pixels if the design only needs a thumbnail.

steps.title: Choose an Appropriate Format
steps.body: JPG is often practical for photos; PNG when you need transparency or crisp graphics; WebP can reduce weight in modern browsers.

steps.title: Adjust Compression
steps.body: Gradually reduce quality and compare edges, text, and detailed areas. The final file should be lighter without losing legibility.

steps.title: Check the Final File
steps.body: Open the exported image, review its dimensions, and remove metadata you don't need to publish.

faqs: What format should I use on a web page?
It depends on the content and the compatibility you need. Compare JPG, PNG, and WebP in the real context of your page.
Does reducing pixels always reduce weight?
It usually helps, but the result also depends on the format, compression, detail, and metadata.
solutions.note: Image optimization does not replace a responsive format strategy, suitable dimensions, and deferred loading on the website.

solutions.title: Prepare Images for Social Media | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Prepare Images for Social Media Posts
solutions.description: Adjust proportions, crop, add watermarks, and create compositions for posts and thumbnails.
solutions.intro: Each platform and posting location may use different proportions. Before exporting, define whether the image will be square, vertical, or horizontal, protect important elements within the frame, and review how it will appear on a small screen.

steps.title: Choose the Posting Location
steps.body: Determine whether you'll prepare a feed post, story, cover, or thumbnail. Don't use a single measurement for all spaces.

steps.title: Adjust the Frame
steps.body: Crop the image without cutting faces, text, or elements that explain the content. Review the safety margins.

steps.title: Add Identity if Necessary
steps.body: Use a discreet watermark when you need attribution or visual protection; avoid covering important information.

steps.title: Export and Check on Mobile
steps.body: Open the final file at reduced size and confirm that the text and main element remain legible.

faqs: Does Prisma publish directly to Instagram or YouTube?
No. These tools prepare files; publication occurs from the corresponding platform.
Is one image suitable for all social media?
No. Check the recommended dimensions and safe zones for each platform before exporting.
solutions.note: Recommended dimensions by social media platforms may change. Verify the current requirements of the platform where you plan to post.

solutions.title: Analyze and Convert CSV, JSON, and Excel Files | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Review and Convert CSV, JSON, and Excel Files
solutions.description: Inspect tables, review statistics, and transform CSV, JSON, and Excel files before importing them into another application.
solutions.primaryQuery: Convert CSV to JSON and Excel Online
solutions.intro: A tabular file may appear correct but still contain duplicate headers, empty rows, unexpected delimiters, or inconsistent value formats. Before converting, it's a good idea to inspect the structure and confirm that the output preserves the fields you need.

steps.title: Inspect the Original File
steps.body: Review headers, delimiters, empty rows, and values that mix numbers, dates, and text. Do not delete columns without confirming their use.

steps.title: Review Statistics
steps.body: Check the number of rows, columns, and values reported by the tool to detect obvious anomalies.

steps.title: Convert to the Necessary Format
steps.body: Choose CSV to JSON or JSON to CSV based on the target application. If working with Excel, use the specific converter and review the resulting workbook.

steps.title: Validate the Output
steps.body: Compare a sample of records with the original file and verify that no leading zeros, accents, or separators have been lost.

faqs: Is CSV the same as Excel?
No. CSV stores tabular text with delimiters; an Excel book can include multiple sheets, formulas, styles, and other elements.
Does the conversion validate data quality?
Not completely. Conversion changes the representation; you must review fields, types, duplicates, and required values.
solutions.note: Do not use personal or confidential data in external services without authorization. Keep a copy of the original file and validate the output before importing it.

solutions.title: File Privacy Before Sharing | Prisma Space
solutions.description: Inspect files, review EXIF metadata and PDF metadata, and clean compatible data before sharing sensitive documents, photos, or text.
solutions.intro: A photo may include date, camera model, or coordinates; a document may retain internal properties. Reviewing these data before sharing helps reduce accidental exposures, although metadata cleaning does not remove visible information within the file.

steps.title: Identify the File
steps.body: Check the type and basic properties to know what format you're reviewing.

steps.title: Check Metadata
steps.body: Inspect EXIF data from an image or available properties from a PDF.

steps.title: Clean Compatible Data
steps.body: Remove metadata from the copy you're sharing and preserve the original if you need to maintain its properties.

steps.title: Review Visible Content
steps.body: Check that names, addresses, numbers, or other data do not remain within the image or visible text.

faqs: Does removing EXIF delete a written location on the image?
No. Metadata and visible content are distinct. If an address appears in the photo, you must edit or censor that part.
Does cleaning guarantee the file is anonymous?
No. Also review the name, content, context, and any data that can identify a person.
solutions.note: File privacy depends on the complete file and publication context. For regulated or confidential documents, follow your organization's policies.

solutions.title: Organize Study Materials and Bibliographic References | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Organize Your Study Sources and Materials
solutions.description: Prepare bibliographic references, locate academic identifiers, and organize study materials with Prisma Space.
solutions.intro: A good study routine requires accessible sources and consistent references. You can use Prisma's tools to prepare citations, extract identifiers, and structure a first draft of a study guide, always maintaining the original source review.

steps.title: Gather Bibliographic Data
steps.body: Note down authors, title, year, journal or publisher, and DOI if available. Do not complete fields you have not been able to verify.

steps.title: Prepare a Reference
steps.body: Select the available style and generate a draft with verified data.

steps.title: Organize Study Materials
steps.body: Extract text from compatible documents or use a study support feature when available.

steps.title: Review and Verify
steps.body: Compare each reference with the original publication and confirm the norms required by your faculty or journal.

faqs: Are generated references ready to submit?
Use them as a draft. Verify each bibliographic data in the original publication and adapt the format to your institution's instructions.
Can I use AI to summarize bibliography?
You can explore available support, but verify each statement with the source and declare AI use if your institution requires it.
solutions.note: Prisma does not replace bibliographic databases nor verify sources independently. The author remains responsible for verifying references.

solutions.title: Prepare Content for YouTube and Social Media | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Prepare Resources for Your Videos and Posts
solutions.description: Organize ideas, prepare thumbnails, extract frames, and adapt visual and audio resources for your content.
solutions.intro: A published video typically requires more than just the recording: title, thumbnail, visual resources, and reusable fragments. This flow combines preparation tools with creative functions in beta, without promising automatic publication or ranking results.

steps.title: Define the Topic and Audience
steps.body: Write the central idea, the benefit for the viewer, and the video format. Use the content kit as a guide to structure a draft.

steps.title: Select a Frame
steps.body: Extract an image from the video and verify that the face, product, or action is distinguishable in small size.

steps.title: Adapt Resources
steps.body: Resize images for each location and preserve the original file to create other variants.

steps.title: Review the Complete Package
steps.body: Verify title, thumbnail, audio, subtitles, and usage rights before uploading the content to the platform.

faqs: Does Prisma publish videos on YouTube?
No. The tools help prepare resources and drafts; you must upload and publish the video from your YouTube account.
Does the AI kit guarantee more views?
No. It may help organize ideas, but performance depends on the content, audience, presentation, and many other factors.
solutions.note: Connected creative functions may be in beta and subject to quotas. Verify music, image, voice, and third-party material rights.

solutions.title: Edit Audio and Video with Online Tools | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Solve Common Audio and Video Tasks
solutions.description: Cut clips, adjust audio, change formats, and prepare videos with multimedia tools from Prisma Space.
solutions.intro: For a one-time task, you might not need a full-fledged editor. You can cut a clip, extract audio, normalize volume, or change dimensions. Some multimedia operations are in beta and may consume a lot of memory; try them first with a copy or a brief clip.

steps.title: Prepare a Copy of the File
steps.body: Check the format, duration, and size. Keep the original in case you need to repeat the process with different settings.

steps.title: Cut the Necessary Segment
steps.body: Define the start and duration with precision and review the result to avoid cutting a word or action.

steps.title: Adjust the Audio or Video
steps.body: Extract audio, normalize volume, or change resolution according to your goal. Do not apply multiple transformations without reviewing each output.

steps.title: Check Compatibility
steps.body: Play the exported file on the device and application where you plan to use it.

faqs: Can I edit multiple tracks at once?
These tools focus on single-point operations; they are not a complete multi-track editor.
Why does a video take a long time or fail?
File size, codec, available memory, and browser all influence the result. Reduce the clip or try a compatible file.
solutions.note: Several multimedia tools are in beta. Check the result and do not use a single export as a backup of the original.

solutions.title: Utilities for coding, validating, and exploring APIs | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Work with code, data, and APIs directly in your browser
solutions.description: Use utilities to format code, validate structures, test regular expressions, decode JWT, and explore public APIs.
solutions.intro: When debugging an integration, a small utility can speed up reviewing a response or structure. This set helps with formatting, validation, and inspection, but does not replace automated testing or security reviews in your project.

steps.title: Isolate the fragment you want to review
steps.body: Remove secrets, active tokens, and personal data before pasting code or responses into a tool.

steps.title: Order and validate the structure
steps.body: Use the formatter or validator compatible with the language and review the indicated errors.

steps.title: Test expressions and values
steps.body: Check regex patterns or inspect the readable part of a JWT. Remember that decoding does not verify the signature.

steps.title: Query the API and verify
steps.body: Explore documentation or a public API and validate the response in your real environment before integrating it.

faqs: Is it safe to paste a real JWT?
No. Use test tokens or fictional data; a JWT may contain sensitive information or active credentials.
Does the explorer test any API?
No. It depends on whether the endpoint is accessible from the browser and its CORS policies, authentication, and limits.
solutions.note: Do not introduce secrets, private keys, or credentials into public tools. Verify outputs within your own development environment.

solutions.title: Create content with artificial intelligence | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Create drafts and resources with AI tools
solutions.description: Explore writing assistants, image generation, prompt improvement, and AI voice, reviewing the requirements of each engine.
solutions.intro: AI can help move from an idea to a first draft, propose alternatives, or prepare creative resources. To get useful results, define the audience, objective, and restrictions; then review data, rights, and tone before publishing. Prisma's features are in beta or dependent on available providers and keys.

steps.title: Define the task and context
steps.body: Explain the objective, audience, format, and restrictions. Avoid including private information or secrets.

steps.title: Prepare a first draft
steps.body: Use the text assistant to structure ideas or write a first version that you can review.

steps.title: Create or adapt a resource
steps.body: When the feature is available, use the image or voice generator to prepare a complementary resource.

steps.title: Review before using it
steps.body: Check facts, usage rights, biases, tone, and sensitive data. Do not publish AI output without human review.

faqs: Is AI-generated content ready for publication?
No. Review accuracy, tone, originality, rights, and platform policies before using it.
Do all AI features have free use?
No. Some are in beta, require connected providers, or need a personal key and may consume external credits.
solutions.note: AI features may change based on provider, availability, and quotas. Do not introduce confidential data or present generated content as verified information without verifying it.
